ws_lead: What JGates found in this project: components, languages and the scope of the analysis. Discovery only reads files.
ws_changes_baseline: First discovery of this session: there is nothing to compare yet.
ws_changes_none: Nothing changed since the previous discovery.
ws_templates_off: In Report only mode the discovery is shown, but no template is activated.
ws_components_empty: No component found. Declare one or check the mode in the Detection and scope tab.
ws_reason_CONFLICTING_LOCKFILES: Lockfiles of different managers in the same folder
ws_reason_VENDOR_DIRECTORY: Third-party code kept in the tree
ws_reason_NOT_DECLARED_IN_EXPLICIT_MODE: Not declared and the mode is Declare
ws_declare_hint: The declaration prevails over the detection of the same path. The file is changed by patch: comments and the rest stay as they are.
ws_tree_note: Summarized tree: only the component roots and the JGates files.
ws_scope_lead: How JGates decides what a component is and which files enter the analysis. The choice is written to .jgates/workspace.yml.
ws_mode_hint_auto: Detects components from manifests and adds what is declared.
ws_mode_hint_explicit: Only what is declared in components counts; what is detected is ignored.
ws_mode_hint_report-only: The discovery is shown, but no template is activated.
ws_mode_note_explicit: To declare components, use the Declare button in the Components tab.
ws_yaml_missing: The file does not exist yet; it is created when the first change is written.
ws_patterns_hint: One pattern per line. Exclusions take priority.
ws_include_hint: Empty includes everything. With patterns, only what matches enters.
ws_preview_nochange: This change does not alter which files enter.
ws_preview_more: Showing the first {limit}; there are more files in this group.
ws_preview_truncated: Reading the tree was cut by the limit; the list may be incomplete.
ws_unsupported_reason: Reason: JGates does not analyze this language yet; it stays out of the templates.
ws_conflict_reason: Reason: there are lockfiles of different managers in the same folder; pick one and declare the component to resolve it.
ws_state_absent: Nothing written: default values (the file does not exist)
